comp.script: window.lowcoder.nwUtils.executeEventFunctionsInSequence([()=>parseState.setValue("processing"),parseFileUpload])

parseState.setValue("disabled")
if(multiPositionSwitch.value==true){
  const emptyArray=[{expenseGroup:"",expenseType:"",amount:"",reimbursable:true,costCenter:"",additionalAttributes:{}}]
  const dataArray=[]
  const typeSet = getNewTypes.data?.data?.ExpenseRuleGeneralExpense.find((elementType)=>elementType?.id==currentExpenseType.value)?.id
    dataArray.push({
      expenseGroup: currentExpenseGroup.value,
expenseType:typeSet ? typeSet :"",
      amount:currentAmount.value,
      reimbursable:isReimbursableSoloSwitch.value,
      costCenter:selectedCostCenter.value,
    additionalAttributes:typeSet && getCustomFieldsTransformer.value.length!=0 ? getCustomFieldsTransformer.value[0]:{}})
    customFieldsMultiData.setValue([{
  id:"",
  infoValue:"",
  mandatory:"",
  value:""
},getCustomFieldsTransformer.value[0]])
  positionsArray.setValue(emptyArray.concat(dataArray)) 
  positionElementTotalAmount.setValue(currentAmount.value)
  positionElementTotalCurrency.setValue(currentCurrency.value)
  positionElementRequest.setValue(currentRequest?.value)
}
else{
  const firstPositionItem = positionsArray.length==1 ? listDataUnIndexed.value[0] : listDataUnIndexed.value[1]
  const typeSet = getNewTypes.data?.data?.ExpenseRuleGeneralExpense.find((elementType)=>elementType?.id==firstPositionItem.expenseType)?.id
    currentAmount.setValue(firstPositionItem?.amount)
  isReimbursableSoloSwitch.setValue(firstPositionItem.reimbursable)
  selectedCostCenter.setValue(firstPositionItem?.costCenter)
  currentCurrency.setValue(positionElementTotalCurrency?.value)
  positionElementRequest.value!="0" && currentRequest.setValue(positionElementRequest?.value)
  currentExpenseGroup.setValue(firstPositionItem.expenseGroup);
  currentExpenseType.setValue(typeSet ? typeSet :"").then(()=>customFieldsSoloData.setValue(firstPositionItem.additionalAttributes)).then(()=>positionsArray.setValue([{expenseGroup:"",expenseType:"",amount:"",reimbursable:true,costCenter:"",additionalAttributes:{}}]))

  
}
parseState.setValue("processed")

currentStep.value == "start"|| currentStep.value == null ?  rowDefinitionState.setValue("1fr 0fr") : rowDefinitionState.setValue("0fr 1fr")
// changeCondition.value ? rowDefinitionState.setValue("0fr 1fr") :

transformers.script:
const dataArray=[]
if(multiPositionSwitch.value==false)
   {
  if(changeCondition.value)
  { 
    const positionObj = {
      "expenseItem":fetchExpenseData.data.data.ExpenseItemByPk.id,
      "expenseGroupRef": currentExpenseGroup.value,
        "expenseTypeRef": currentExpenseType.value,
        "totalAmount": currentAmount.value,
        "positionOrder": 1,
        "costCenter": currentCostCenter.value,
      "reimbursable":isReimbursableSoloSwitch.value,
      "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":currentExpenseType.value,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":getCustomFieldsTransformer.value},
      "source":currentExpenseType.value ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" : "",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
    }
    const findObj = checkPositionExists.value(positionObj)
    if(findObj)
    dataArray.push({
      "id":findObj.id,
      "version":findObj.version,
       ...positionObj
                    })
  else  dataArray.push({
      "expenseItem":fetchExpenseData.data.data.ExpenseItemByPk.id,
       "expenseGroupRef": currentExpenseGroup.value,
        "expenseTypeRef":   currentExpenseType.value,
        "totalAmount": currentAmount.value,
        "positionOrder": 1,
    "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":currentExpenseType.value,
        "costCenter": currentCostCenter.value,
      "reimbursable":isReimbursableSoloSwitch.value,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":getCustomFieldsTransformer.value},
    "source":currentExpenseType.value ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" : "",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
  })}
  else
  dataArray.push({
      "expenseGroupRef": currentExpenseGroup.value,
        "expenseTypeRef":  currentExpenseType.value,
        "totalAmount": currentAmount.value,
        "positionOrder": 1,
    "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":currentExpenseType.value,
        "costCenter": currentCostCenter.value,
      "reimbursable":isReimbursableSoloSwitch.value,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":getCustomFieldsTransformer.value},
    "source":currentExpenseType.value ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" : "",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
  })
    return dataArray
}
listData.value.forEach((element,index)=>{
  if(changeCondition.value)
  { 
    const positionObj = {
      "expenseItem":fetchExpenseData.data.data.ExpenseItemByPk.id,
      "expenseGroupRef": element.expenseGroup,
        "totalAmount": element.amount,
      "expenseTypeRef":  element.expenseType,
        "positionOrder": index+1,
      "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":element.expenseType,
        "costCenter": element.costCenter,
      "reimbursable":element.reimbursable,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":element.additionalAttributes},
    "source":element.expenseType ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" :"",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
    }
    const findObj = checkPositionExists.value(positionObj)
    if(findObj)
    dataArray.push({
      "id":findObj.id,
      "version":findObj.version,
       ...positionObj
  })
  else  dataArray.push({
    "expenseItem":fetchExpenseData.data.data.ExpenseItemByPk.id,
        "expenseGroupRef": element.expenseGroup,
        "totalAmount": element.amount,
        "positionOrder": index+1,
    "expenseTypeRef":  element.expenseType,
    "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":element.expenseType,
        "costCenter": element.costCenter,
      "reimbursable":element.reimbursable,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":element.additionalAttributes},
   "source":element.expenseType ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" :"",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
  })}
  else
  dataArray.push({
        "expenseGroupRef": element.expenseGroup,
        "totalAmount": element.amount,
        "positionOrder": index+1,
    "expenseTypeRef":  element.expenseType,
        "costCenter": element.costCenter,
    "expenseRuleGeneralExpense":element.expenseType,
      "reimbursable":element.reimbursable,
      "additionalProperties":{"customFields":element.additionalAttributes},
    "source":element.expenseType ? "GENERAL_EXPENSE_RULE" :"",
     "expenseRule":getEmployeeRuleQuery.data.expenseRuleId || ""
  })
})
return dataArray
